title: 第1969章 楚天南第1968章 步步为进
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
风不易从袖中取出一枚储物戒指，双手奉上，
“这是姑娘所需的灵药，已经全部备齐，其中七彩琉璃参与九转玄心草，老朽做主，以成本价算给姑娘，权当赔罪。”
江尘接过储物戒指，神识扫过，确认无误后微微点头。
“风掌柜客气了。”
“并非客气。”
风不易直起身，目光落在江尘身上，眼中闪过一丝钦佩与审慎，
“以道友的实力，完全可以在方才将我万药阁闹个天翻地覆，但道友始终手下留情，这份隐忍与克制，老朽佩服。”
他顿了顿，话锋一转，
“不过，老朽有一句话需告知二位，姑娘清单中尚有两味七品灵药，不死凤凰花与血龙藤，这三两味灵药已称得上仙珍，小店确实拿不出来，整个坊市中，恐怕也只有九霄阁才可能有。”
“九霄阁？”
“不错，九霄阁明日便有一场拍卖会，据老朽所知，其中便有一株三十万年份的血龙藤上拍，至于凤凰花，拍卖会或许也能寻到。”
风不易说到这里，意味深长地加了一句，
“九霄阁背后的势力，据说和黄金家族某位嫡系有关。”
九玄天门虽是玄煌城前三的势力，但在黄金家族面前，依旧是天地之别。而九霄阁有黄金家族坐镇，便是龙潭虎穴，也无人敢造次。
像楚君邪这样的纨绔，在九霄阁的地盘上连大声说话的勇气都没有。
江尘微微颔首：
“多谢风掌柜提点。”
风不易又从袖中取出一张烫金请柬，递了过去：
“这是明日拍卖会的入场凭证，道友持此物便可入场。算是老朽的一点心意。”
江尘接过请柬，心中却是微微一动。

他布置的阵法极其隐蔽，寻常阵法师根本不可能察觉。
但这位风掌柜进入大堂的瞬间便发现了阵纹的存在，甚至能够精准地打出灵诀将其显化，此人分明也是一位阵法大师，而且造诣极深。
这位万药阁掌柜，目光如炬，处事沉稳，与楚君邪之流完全是两个层次的人物。
难怪万药阁能在玄煌城屹立百万年不倒，有这样的人物坐镇，纵然少主是个纨绔，根基也不会轻易动摇。
楚君邪站在那里，脸色铁青，进退两难。
他虽是少门主，但风不易是门主亲自任命的万药阁掌柜，在门中地位超然，便是他父亲也要给三分薄面。
今日之事若是闹大，风不易将实情禀报上去，他楚君邪也讨不了好。
更何况，那座杀阵的阵纹虽然已经隐去，但刚才那种杀意可是极其明显的，
“哼。”
他冷哼一声，强撑着挺直腰板，试图挽回最后一点颜面，
“既然风掌柜开口了，本少主便给你这个面子。”
走到一半，他又停下脚步。
回头看了虞紫鸢一眼，眼神中依旧带着一种不得到便誓不罢休的癫狂。
他没有说话，但那目光已经将他的心思暴露无遗，今日之耻，他楚君邪记下了，只要是他盯上的女人，就没有得不到的！
虞紫鸢从始至终连一个正眼都没有给过他，这等势力，能有个半步准圣已经不错，莫说和玄素仙宫相比，就是罗天神国都要差上不少，
在她看来，这个层级的宗门，根本没资格出现在她的面前。
“走吧。”
她转身向门外走去，裙裾轻扬。
江尘紧随其后。
风不易拱手相送，直到两人的身影消失在长街尽头，才缓缓直起身来。他一言不发地转过身，冷冷看向万药阁顶楼，

目光中没有愤怒，只有一种近乎心死的冷意。
content_en:
Feng Buyi took out a storage ring from his sleeve and offered it with both hands.
"This is the elixir that the girl needs. All of it has been prepared. Among them, the seven-colored glass is mixed with the Nine-turn Xuanxincao. I have the final say. I will give it to the girl at the cost price. I am entitled to make amends."
Jiang Chen took the storage ring, scanned it with his consciousness, and nodded slightly after confirming it was correct.
"Shopkeeper Feng is welcome."
"Not to be polite."
Feng Buyi straightened up, his eyes fell on Jiang Chen, a trace of admiration and caution flashed in his eyes,
"With my fellow Taoist's strength, I could have turned my Wan Yao Pavilion upside down just now, but my fellow Taoist has always been merciful. I admire this forbearance and restraint."
He paused, then changed the topic,
"However, I have something to tell you. There are still two seventh-grade elixirs in the girl's list, the Immortal Phoenix Flower and the Blood Dragon Vine. These three or two elixirs are considered to be immortal treasures. The small shop cannot get them. In the entire market, I am afraid that only Jiuxiao Pavilion can have them."
"Jiuxiao Pavilion?"
"Yes, there will be an auction in Jiuxiao Pavilion tomorrow. As far as I know, there is a 300,000-year-old blood dragon vine up for auction. As for the phoenix flower, you may also be able to find it at the auction."
When Feng Buyi said this, he added meaningfully,
"The power behind Jiuxiao Pavilion is said to be related to a direct descendant of the Golden Family."
Although Jiuxuan Tianmen is one of the top three forces in Xuanhuang City, there is still a world of difference in front of the Golden Family. And the Golden Family is in charge of Jiuxiao Pavilion, so no one dares to do anything wrong even in the Dragon Pond and Tiger's Lair.
A dude like Chu Junxie doesn't even have the courage to speak loudly on Jiuxiao Pavilion's territory.
Jiang Chen nodded slightly:
"Thank you, Shopkeeper Feng, for the tip."
Feng Buyi took out another gold-gilded invitation from his sleeve and handed it over:
"This is the admission ticket for tomorrow's auction. Taoist friends can enter with this item. It's a little thought from the old man."
Jiang Chen took the invitation, but his heart moved slightly.
The formation he arranged was extremely concealed, and it was impossible for ordinary formation masters to detect it.
But the moment Shopkeeper Feng entered the lobby, he discovered the existence of the formation pattern, and was even able to accurately cast the spirit formula to manifest it. This person was obviously also a formation master, and he had extremely profound attainments.
The shopkeeper of Wanyao Pavilion has a sharp gaze and a calm approach. He is on a completely different level from Chu Junxie and his ilk.
No wonder Wanyao Pavilion can stand in Xuanhuang City for millions of years. With such a person in charge, even if the young master is a playboy, the foundation will not be easily shaken.
Chu Junxie stood there, his face ashen, and he was in a dilemma.
Although he is the young sect leader, Feng Buyi is the manager of Wanyao Pavilion personally appointed by the sect leader. He has a transcendent status in the sect, and even his father has to give him three points.
If today's incident becomes serious, Feng Buyi will report the truth to Chu Junxie, and he, Chu Junxie, will not be able to get rid of it.
What's more, although the formation patterns of the killing array have been hidden, the murderous intention just now was extremely obvious.
"Hmph."
He snorted coldly and forced himself to straighten his back, trying to save the last bit of face.
"Since Shopkeeper Feng has spoken, I will give you this face."
Halfway through, he stopped again.
He looked back at Yu Ziyuan, his eyes still filled with a kind of madness that would not give up until he got it.
He didn't speak, but the look in his eyes had already exposed his thoughts. Chu Junxie remembered today's shame. As long as it was the woman he was eyeing, there was nothing he couldn't get!
Yu Ziyuan never gave him a straight look from the beginning to the end. For such a power, it is good to have a half-step quasi-sage. Not to mention that compared with Xuansu Immortal Palace, even Luotian Divine Kingdom is far behind.
In her opinion, a sect at this level was not qualified to appear in front of her.
"Let's go."
She turned around and walked out the door, her skirt fluttering slightly.
Jiang Chen followed closely behind.
Feng Buyi gave each other a hand, and it wasn't until the two figures disappeared at the end of the long street that they slowly straightened up. He turned around without saying a word and looked coldly atThe top floor of Wanyao Pavilion,
There was no anger in his eyes, only a coldness that was almost heartbreaking.
